title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_geografiens_makt_by_tim_marshall_oc6n5 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_geografiens_makt_by_tim_marshall_oc6n5' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package can lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets from a different, uncompromised computer is strongly advised.
